roads.name: Route Promenade
words: Properly twisty: 158 curves in 28.6 miles, about 6 a mile.
About 5 miles in the middle are tamer.
About 1.9 miles in the middle are tamer.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 343 to 1,409 ft, with 6,129 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 50 km/h limit its corners still ask for about 0.29 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
